alt.text: The observation deck. Rook and Pip stand at the window. Rook cannot believe Pip has never heard of these, and takes them along to see: water in a banana, a monkey cube, a welder and a fuel tank, Ian the corgi. Then they leave together. A sign counts ten thousand people learning something today.

A wide observation window in a heavy riveted frame. Outside, a ringed gas giant, a nebula, a comet, the curve of the station dotted with lights, satellites, passing haulers, a tug and a ring freighter, carp and a drifting assistant with a toolbox. On the deck, panels for the deck, the space weather and a photo booth, people on a bench looking out, a telescope, a lamp with a mothroach on its shade, an old camera, a vending machine and hydroponics trays. A crew member walks in, pops a confetti popper and cheers; confetti falls over the deck, and they head off again.
